messages.subject: Caspian / Stratton Energy MSA – execution version
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Catherine, Sofia,

Attached is the execution version of the Master SaaS Agreement, incorporating everything agreed. We propose to exchange signed signature pages by email, to be held to order and released on completion. We'll circulate the signature pack separately. Could each side return a signed signature page by tomorrow so we can complete on 22 May?

Kind regards,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
